mode: contract — binds P4S-31D1-B implementation; no ambient/mobile/desktop-app activation authorized
doctrine: Voice is a governed voice-MESSAGE rail, not dictation. Recording produces a reviewable draft object; nothing enters Cockpit Chat until the operator explicitly sends. Only after send: Cockpit Chat -> IntentSpec -> WorkPacket/gate/proof. The D1-A behavior (transcript auto-dispatched into chat on silence) is REPLACED.

reuses.upload_seam: existing /chat/upload media path is the candidate audio-artifact upload seam (lane F decides; MediaAttachment shape already renders in chat)

VoiceMessageDraft.description: Client-side reviewable draft. NOT a chat message. Exists from recording start until send or delete.

fields.voice_turn_id: vt-<uuid> — threads capture -> transcript -> chat -> loop (existing assembler id)
fields.audio_artifact: AudioArtifactRef | null — null only before recording completes; NEVER null after stop (audio is preserved even when STT fails)
fields.transcript: string — finalized text, editable by operator before send
fields.transcript_partial: string — provisional display only; MUST NEVER be committed as chat content
fields.transcript_status: enum: pending | partial | final | failed | edited
fields.confidence: float 0..1 | null — from STT when available; low confidence blocks nothing but is displayed
fields.device_registry_id: string — from routing metadata, never hardcoded
fields.consent_grant_id: vcg-<id> — the active VoiceConsentGrant(push_to_talk) under which capture ran
fields.status: enum: recording | transcribing | ready | sent | failed | deleted

invariants: carries_audio over the chat seam = false — the chat message carries an artifact REFERENCE, not audio bytes
draft.status transitions: recording -> transcribing -> ready -> (sent | deleted); failed -> (retry -> transcribing) | deleted
no chat message may exist for a draft whose status is not 'sent'
identity is never stamped client-side; server resolves the Clerk principal on send

AudioArtifactRef.description: Pointer to the stored audio, per UMH storage law.

fields.artifact_id: string — storage id from the upload seam
fields.url: string — tenant/session-scoped retrieval URL (authenticated route, never public)

storage_law: tenant/user/session scoped — retrieval requires the authenticated operator session
no plaintext secrets in path or metadata
retention: operator data, lives with chat history; delete-before-send removes the artifact
audio bytes never logged; never sent to any endpoint other than the storage seam and (for STT) the voice server

RecordingSessionState.description: Explicit client state machine (replaces implicit micState-only flow).
rules: paused_speech_gap is INTERNAL: short silences render a paused indicator at most; they never finalize
finalizing is reached ONLY by manual_stop, silence >= vad.min_silence_before_finalize_ms (when auto_finalize mode on), or max duration cap
review is mandatory before sending unless mode.auto_send explicitly true (default false)
cancel from any pre-sent state deletes the draft and leaves NO chat trace

VadConfig.description: Configurable pause detection. Defaults tuned for sentence-internal pauses.

fields.silence_threshold_level: float, default 0.02 — audio level below which a window counts as silence
fields.min_speech_ms: int, default 400 — minimum speech before a turn is accepted at all (else NO_SPEECH, draft recoverable)
fields.intra_utterance_pause_ms: int, default 1500 — silences shorter than this are ignored (sentence-internal)
fields.min_silence_before_finalize_ms: int, default 2500 — continuous silence required before auto-FINALIZE (finalize != send; it moves the draft to review)
fields.max_recording_ms: int, default 120000 — hard cap; finalizes to review
fields.auto_send: bool, default false — sending ALWAYS requires explicit operator action unless a future mode explicitly permits; no current mode permits

VoiceDiagnostics.description: Per-draft capture diagnostics for tuning and proof.

fields.silence_windows: [{start_ms, end_ms}] — observed silences and whether each was ignored/finalizing
fields.transcript_partial_events: int count (content NOT stored in diagnostics)

VoiceDiagnostics.logging_law: diagnostics carry timings and counts, never transcript text; any debug preview bounded <=40 chars at DEBUG only

ux_states.bubble: voice message renders as a chat-style bubble/card: recording indicator + duration while recording; audio playback affordance + transcript UNDERNEATH once available

operator_actions.send: only when transcript_status in {final, edited} and status == ready
operator_actions.retry: re-run STT against the preserved audio artifact
operator_actions.edit: inline transcript edit before send; sets transcript_status=edited
operator_actions.delete: discard draft + artifact; no chat trace

forbidden: premature paste of any transcript (partial or final) into the message input
committing a partial transcript as final content

stt_quality.engine_now: server STT via umh/voice_server.py — Groq whisper-large-v3-turbo, faster-whisper fallback
requirements: surface confidence/error state when the engine provides it; unknown -> null, displayed as none
audio preserved on STT failure — retry uses the stored artifact, never re-recording by force
low-confidence transcript never auto-enters the intent loop: operator send IS the confirmation gate
engine comparison vs any LifeOS path recorded in the Lane A recon report before implementation locks the engine choice

intent_loop_handoff.on_send: sendMessage(finalized_transcript, 'voice', routing+{voice_message: {draft_id, artifact_id, duration_ms, transcript_status, consent_grant_id}}, voice_turn_id) -> POST /advisor/converse
intent_loop_handoff.rail: unchanged: try_chat_intent_rail -> classify_intent(text) -> governed_intent_submit -> held gate -> decide -> proof
intent_loop_handoff.proof_requirement: loop record carries the finalized transcript verbatim; the chat message metadata carries the audio artifact pointer; proof records voice did not bypass Chat

hard_constraints: voice remains an adapter into Cockpit Chat; no separate execution path
no ambient wake word; no always-on mic; no mobile activation beyond evidence
no provider execution; no live projection DB writes
no plaintext secrets; no transcript/audio leakage; no raw transcript INFO logs

lane_g_proof_plan.surface: desktop browser Chrome on executor-role node (Browser Verification Law)
steps: authenticate via Clerk; consent active (inline enable if not)
record an utterance CONTAINING mid-sentence pauses > intra_utterance_pause_ms/2 — verify no premature finalize/send
observe bubble: recording indicator, duration, transcript appears underneath, status transitions
server truth: loop held at AWAITING_APPROVAL with edited transcript verbatim; artifact pointer in message metadata; approve/reject -> proof_recorded in-thread
negative: record + delete -> assert no chat message, no loop entry; record with silence-only -> recoverable draft, no chat message
capture DOM/screenshot, network trace, consent grant id, proof id, tests/gates output, secret scan
